description: 54 steps, each one action of a player, listing the inventory packets that follow it with their state ids: held slot changes, empty maps (a stack and the last one), empty buckets on water and at the sky, water buckets poured, a knowledge book, a stick, a filled map and an empty hand used, dirt placed, an item and a stack dropped and picked up again, hands swapped, a map and a bucket used from the off hand, a crafting table with dirt in its grid and a chest opened and closed, a map used and dropped and a bucket filled and poured with the chest open, and a map, a bucket and a knowledge book used in creative mode; Circuit and both official servers send the same packets
